nurs.title: Bethel University (TN) - Nursing, Direct Entry B.S.N.

test_policy.notes: Test optional for applicants with a weighted GPA of 2.25 or above; applicants below 2.25 must submit ACT or SAT. Writing is not considered and tests are superscored.

requirements.notes: Non-refundable $30 fee; apply on Bethel's online application or the Common App. Official transcripts must come directly from the high school. The admissions pages are dated to the 2025-26 cycle (applications open Aug. 1, 2025), so dates for fall 2027 are assumed to repeat.

deadlines.label: Application deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Fall July 31, spring Dec. 15, summer May 15 (same dates on the international page). Printed for the 2025-26 cycle with no fall 2027 date, so this assumes the date repeats. The page also lists Dec. 1, 2025 as the 'Application Deadline for Top Scholarships'; the equivalent date for fall 2027 entry is not yet published.

english_policy.waiver_notes: International page lists minimums for TOEFL (paper 513, computer-based 183, internet 65), iTEP 3.6, IELTS 5 overall with 5 in each area, and Duolingo 80 or above. PTE is not listed. If TOEFL is not available, the page describes a video and audio interview as an alternative. Conditional admission / ESL pathway is not described.

english.notes: Internet-based minimum 65 (paper 513, computer-based 183). No 1-6 scale minimum is given.
5 overall with 5 in each exam area.

cost.notes: International in-person 2026-27: tuition for 12-18 hours $10,080 per semester ($20,160 per year); residence hall and meal plan $5,760 per semester ($11,520 per year; varies by hall and plan). Page estimate $31,680 per year excludes course fees and books (books $37 per credit hour, opt-out possible). Required international student insurance $2,114 per year. 2024-25 College Navigator listing was $18,712 tuition and fees.

aid.notes: The international tuition/aid page lists first-year academic merit awards of $4,000-$12,000 per year (Presidential $12,000, Trustee $10,000, Provost $8,000, Deans $6,000, Bethel Honor $4,000); a 3.0 cumulative GPA or ACT 20 (if submitted) is considered competitive. Hendrix Scholarship (full tuition/fees/room/meals or tuition/fees) needs 3.5 GPA or ACT 24/SAT 1190; its listed deadline was Dec. 1, 2025. Athletic and Renaissance (audition) scholarships also exist. Need-based aid for international students is not described. Awards cover fall and spring for up to ten semesters.

majors.notes: First-year direct entry needs a 3.0 high school GPA or ACT 20 / SAT 1030. The page does not state enrollment caps or whether international students are eligible, so confirm with admissions.
